item.title: Jim Lovell, Commander Of NASA's Apollo 13 Moon Mission, Dies At 97

media:content.media:description: Jim Lovell never got another chance to walk on the moon after Apollo 13.

item.description: -American astronaut Jim Lovell, commander of the failed 1970 mission to the moon that nearly ended in disaster but became an inspirational saga of survival and the basis for the hit movie "Apollo 13," has died at the age of 97, NASA said on Friday.
